about.text:
Before there was a library in Fairview, there was a reading room. Many citizens of Fairview went to the reading room to read the current magazines and books of the era.
The Fairview Municipal Library was founded on April 9th, 1909, and the first library director was Miss Lucas.
Children’s services started in earnest in March 1917, with the addition of the “Children’s Hour.”
The library moved to the municipal auditorium in 1939.
The longest serving librarian was Miss Ula Frost from July 16th, 1912 to her retirement 43 years later in 1955.
Under the direction of Dee Wilson, the Fairview Library started offering “Summer Reading Programs” in the summer of 1982.
Motto: The Fairview City Library strives to fulfill the informational needs of all adults and children with the most desirable reading, current educational material, and activities with a friendly, personalized service to all patrons.

library-board.text: The Fairview City Library Board of Trustees is an advisory board appointed by the City Council.
The board meets in open session on the third Thursday of every month at 4:00pm in the city building complex. The public is invited and encouraged to attend and participate in these meetings.
Library Board members as of July, 2025: Elizabeth Fuchs, Charley Bromlow, Tammy Kliewer, Margaret O’Malley, and  Natalie Gonzalez

faq.text: FAQ
Library FAQ
General Information
What are the library hours? The library is open Monday to Friday from 8:30 AM to 6 PM and closed on Saturdays and Sundays.
Where is the library located? The library is located at 123 S. 6th Fairview, OK .
Membership
How do I get a library card? You can apply for a library card online in person.
Is there a fee for a library card? No, obtaining a library card is free for residents of the area.
Borrowing Materials
How long can I borrow books? Most books can be borrowed for two weeks . Some materials may have different loan periods.
Can I renew my items? Yes, items can be renewed by phone, or in person unless they are on hold for another patron.
Digital Resources
Does the library offer e-books? Yes, the library provides access to a variety of e-books and audiobooks through Libby .
How can I access online databases? You can access online databases through the library’s website with your library card number.
Programs and Events
Does the library host events? Yes, the library hosts various events, including book clubs, author readings, and children's storytime.
Are there programs for children and teens? Yes, we offer a range of programs tailored for children and teens, including summer reading challenges and educational workshops.
Technology and Services
Is there free Wi-Fi available? Yes, free Wi-Fi is available throughout the library.
Can I print or copy documents? Yes, the library has printing and copying services available for a small fee.
Contact Information
How can I contact the library? You can reach us by phone at (580) 227-2190 or email us at librarian@fairviewok.org .

join-fol.text: FRIENDS OF THE LIBRARY (FOL): The Friends Of The Fairview City Library is a volunteer group of women and men who are interested in the development and progress of the library services in Fairview. They conduct fundraisers, assist the library staff and provide improvements to the library for the use and benefit of the Citizens. The Friends meet the third Tuesday at 6:00 pm on January 14th, 2025; April 15th, 2025; July 15th, 2025; October 21st, 2025. If you are interested in becoming a Friend Of The Library, please join us at the next meeting or talk with any of the library staff
Again if you wish to join FOL, please let library staff know. We would love for you to join and be a part of our library!
